title: Coral Essex Spa

services.name: Massage
services.desc: Coral Essex Spa provides relaxing, personalized massage therapy in Lower East Side Manhattan, NY for clients looking to step away from the pace of the city and make time for themselves. Since 2008, our licensed massage therapists have served clients from the Lower East Side, Chinatown, East Village, and surrounding Manhattan neighborhoods. Our massage options include full body massage, deep tissue massage, foot massage, couples massage, hydrotherapy, and Vichy table shower experiences. Whether you want a soothing session after a long week or more focused bodywork for areas that feel tight and overworked, our therapists can help you choose an experience that fits what you are looking for.

blurb: Serving Lower East Side Manhattan, NY, Chinatown and East Village, NY for more than a decade, Coral Essex Spa specializes in massage therapy, including full-body, back, and foot massages.
